name: MISTY MDRO Regular - ST (BIS)
summary: MISTY MDRO Regular – ST (BIS) is a compact and easily serviceable RO water purifier designed for brackish water applications with TDS levels below 3000 PPM. It provides 12 LPH purification , 8-litre storage , and over 40% recovery , with a durable stainless-steel storage tank and silver-finish cabinet.
